metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by gunkr-com, grouped by category: mods that change how Claude Code looks and behaves, and herdr integrations

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: Shows the git branch, context window usage, what the last turn added, and plan limit usage above the prompt

plugins.name: auto-pin
plugins.description: Pins a new session in the desktop app's sidebar as it starts

plugins.name: context-handoff
plugins.description: For the desktop app: past a context threshold, records a hand-off and continues from the notes in a new desktop-app session (or after a compaction in place, or the app's clear)

plugins.name: context-handoff-cli
plugins.description: For the terminal: past a context threshold, records a hand-off, starts a fresh session in the same terminal with /clear, and continues from the notes

plugins.name: session-end-unpin
plugins.description: Unpins the session from the desktop app's sidebar once you ask to end it and Claude finds nothing left

plugins.name: herdr-bg-status
plugins.description: In herdr, keeps a Claude Code session shown as working while its background shells, agents or backgrounded MCP calls still run after the turn ends

plugins.name: herdr-usage
plugins.description: Shows Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity and Ollama Cloud subscription usage in the Herdr app's status bar, with a detail popup; its skill installs, updates, checks and removes it
